name: gap-web-search-serpapi
about: tools.webSearch provider=serpapi（additionalWebSearch.ts）：GET，engine/q/api_key/gl 查询参数；organic_results 解析；配置里的 searchEngine 基线不传给工具（ProjectExecutionWorldBundle.ts:120-133），总是 google。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
tools:
  webSearch:
    enabled: true
    provider: serpapi
    endpoint: {MOCK}/serpapi
    apiKey: key-serpapi
    searchEngine: bing
